params.kind: Which contract family to look in.

checkRole(string,bytes32,address).details: OpenZeppelin AccessControl roles (`DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE` is bytes32(0), the others keccak256 of their      name). For the contract named `Roles`, a title of its catalogue (keccak256("vip"), "mvp"...) is      answered with `Roles.holds`, so an agent's mandate can read both kinds the same way. An expired      title is not held.
